notes: Variable adjective: changes to ठंडे (ṭhanḍe) for masculine plural/oblique and ठंडी (ṭhanḍī) for feminine.
Do not confuse with the feminine noun ठंड (ṭhanḍ), which means 'coldness' or 'cold weather' (e.g., आज बहुत ठंड है).
